errors.bad_response: Unexpected answer from the OPNsense API
errors.no_default_route: No interface with a default route found
errors.no_interface: No interface set (enter one or turn on auto-detect)

panel.copy_hint: Click to copy "{id}" for the interface setting
panel.title: OPNsense Traffic

allow_insecure_tls.description: Skip certificate checks. Only for a self-signed certificate you cannot replace.
allow_insecure_tls.label: Allow untrusted certificate

auto_detect.description: With no interface set, use the one carrying the default route. Needs the privilege "Status: Interfaces".
auto_detect.label: Detect WAN automatically

credentials_file.description: File with key=… and secret=… lines, as OPNsense downloads it. Keep it chmod 600.
credentials_file.label: API key file

hidden_interfaces.label: Hidden interfaces
hidden_interfaces.description: Identifiers, names or devices to leave out of the panel; their counters are not evaluated. The eye button in the panel hides more on top of this list.

highlight_color.description: The value fades to this color between the two highlight thresholds (needs a line speed).
highlight_color.label: Highlight color

highlight_from.label: Highlight from (% of line)
highlight_from.description: Below this share of the line speed the value keeps the bar color.

highlight_full.label: Full highlight at (% of line)
highlight_full.description: From this share of the line speed the value has the full highlight color.

interface.description: Identifier (opt1), name (WAN) or device (pppoe0). The panel lists all of them.
interface.label: Interface

line_down_mbit.description: Your line's bandwidth in Mbit/s, for example from your provider contract. Scales gauge and graph and turns on the highlight. 0 scales to the highest rate seen and never highlights.
line_down_mbit.label: Line speed down (Mbit/s)

line_up_mbit.description: Your line's bandwidth in Mbit/s, for example from your provider contract. Scales gauge and graph and turns on the highlight. 0 scales to the highest rate seen and never highlights.
line_up_mbit.label: Line speed up (Mbit/s)

peak_hold_hours.label: Keep peaks (hours)
peak_hold_hours.description: How long a measured peak counts for the adaptive scale (no line speed set). 0 keeps it until you reset it in the panel. Stored on disk, survives restarts. Does not add API requests.

url.description: Base URL of the web GUI, e.g. https://opnsense.lan:443
url.label: OPNsense URL

wan_interfaces.label: WAN-side interfaces
wan_interfaces.description: Interfaces counted from the firewall side (received = download). All others are counted from the network behind them, so download is what their clients download. Empty: interfaces with a default route plus any with "wan" in identifier or name.
